treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Moldova and the Government of the Republic of Turkey for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (1998, with Protocol)
eif_quote: [MD MoF list, status 20.06.2022] Republica Turcia | Convenția | 25.06.1998, Chișinău | 28.07.2000 | 01.01.2001 (signed | entry into force | date of application)
source_title: MD MoF English text of the MD–TR Agreement (Turcia_eng.pdf) and Protocol (Protocol_Turcia_eng.pdf)

rates.quote: the tax so charged shall not exceed: a) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: none (Moldova not MLI signatory; no treaty PPT)

notes: Art. 11(3): interest paid to the Government/Central Bank of Turkey or Government/National Bank of Moldova exempt at source (not modelled). Protocol: Turkish 'dividends' include income from investment funds and trusts. Art. 27: WHT effect on income derived on or after 1 January following EIF (2000 -> 2001-01-01). Moldova is not an MLI signatory, so the MLI (incl. Art. 7 PPT) does not modify this treaty; no PPT/main-purpose clause found in the treaty text read.
